title: Skydive Toledo

services.name: tandem jumps
services.desc: At Skydive Toledo, your first jump is more than a thrill - it’s a story you’ll tell forever. Tucked in the shadow of Mt. St. Helens, surrounded by evergreens and volcanoes, our dropzone has been turning first-timers into sky family for more than 50 years. For tandem skydiving in Washington, there’s simply no place like Skydive Toledo. When the door opens, you fall into free air, wide-open beauty, and a moment that’s entirely your own. We can’t wait for you to go skydiving tandem with us! Arrive at your scheduled time, check in at the front desk, and get ready for an epic experience. services.name: Skydive Toledo
services.desc: Skydive Toledo welcomes up jumpers from across the PNW and beyond. We offer a laid-back vibe and everything you need to jump all day and play into the night. Whether you’re here to turn points, swoop the landing area, or just enjoy our supportive sky fam, welcome! Skydive Toledo was built by skydivers, for skydivers. We’re not just about altitude; we’re big into atmosphere, too. We offer the space and support to help you stay current, progress your skills, and enjoy the ride.
